name: Zenith Lupine Force
name_jp: 究極ルパインフォース
effects: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Kelger (Earth)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Kelger (Earth)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Kelger (Earth)
description.text: Increases [Earth Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Kelger (Earth) after using two Earth abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Lupine Fang+
description.text: 3/5/7 single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) if the user has Physical Blink 0/1/2, capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, grants [Physical Blink 1] and [Physical Blink Stacking 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Kelger (Earth)
description.text: 4/6/8 single attacks (0.80/0.90 each) if user has Physical Blink 0/1/2, higher multiplier if exploiting Earth weakness

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
